references.definition: R stats documents3 through5000 nonmissing observations. This is a reviewed reference definition, not permission to change GUI eligibility or engine constants.
At least3 observations; documentation qualifies p-value accuracy above5000. Core coefficient/constant accuracy remains a separate restricted review.
Combines skewness and kurtosis; documented minimum8 differs from the retained BESH minimum9. No domain or tail change is authorized.
Fixed marginal conditional test; alternative/tail and conditional odds-ratio confidence interval must be specified. This is distinct from a cohort risk ratio.
Paired binary discordant cells define the hypothesis; the small-discordant-count reference uses a binomial distribution. Table orientation and two-sided convention must be retained explicitly.

The paper is matched-pair case-referent analysis and describes the discordant ratio r/s with historical relative-risk terminology. Scientific interpretation is design-dependent; blindly replacing the label or substituting cohort RR is not justified.
Paired and independent tests, Welch versus pooled variance, alternative-specific confidence intervals and confidence level are explicit reference choices.
Rank-sum versus signed-rank, symmetry, exact/tie handling and continuity correction are separate method choices; no new Friedman/Nemenyi feature is authorized.
Mean versus median centering are distinct variance-test options; the selected BESH alias and its report label are preserved.
